name: POLS 3670
title: LGBTQ+ Politics in the United States
description: (Also offered as WGSS 3670.) A brief history of the LGBTQ+ population in the United States and an understanding of how members of that community engage in the political process.
requirement_description: Recommended Preparation: ENGL 1010, POLS 1602, WGSS 2250; Recommended for upper-level students. Not open for credit to students who have passed POLS 2998 when offered as "LGBTQ+ Politics in the US."
